subject: Kickoff: COLA audio embeddings as a platform backbone
body:
Hi Deshawn,

Kickoff for the audio embeddings track. We're standing up COLA — our open-source contrastive audio pre-training method — as the shared audio backbone for data-platforms. The library already supports the three modes we need: SSL pre-training, downstream fine-tuning (DS), and a supervised-from-scratch baseline (SUP), so this is productionizing rather than inventing.

Plan of record: pre-train on LibriSpeech, validate with a linear probe on Speech Commands, then offer frozen-encoder embeddings as a platform service. Success metric for the half: downstream teams get within 2 points of a task-specific supervised model using our frozen embeddings.

Milestones: pre-training reproduced by end of April, downstream evals in May, platform integration decision mid-June. Staffing and compute ask by 4/10?

Thanks,
Dmitri
